scope: Natural public HTTP journeys only; original 70 document contract cases remain strict API coverage tests.
original_results_are_immutable: The first 28 holdout transcripts and their original scores must not be overwritten.

corrections_and_independent_rationale.change: Recognize the actual clarification state only when it contains an actionable pending service choice.
corrections_and_independent_rationale.reason: A host state label is not a business outcome. This removes a transport-vocabulary mismatch without declaring an irrelevant service chooser a useful business answer; that remains an independent semantic check.

corrections_and_independent_rationale.change: Only actual HTTP chat and input text can provide user facts and identifier provenance.
corrections_and_independent_rationale.reason: Future scripted answers not delivered to the model were incorrectly included in the old source-of-identifier check. A model must not receive credit for using facts it never observed.

corrections_and_independent_rationale.change: A private expected target that depends on an unsent clarification is deferred, not a hard failure and not a pass.
corrections_and_independent_rationale.reason: An evaluator cannot require the model to infer an answer withheld by the test runner. Independent review must still determine whether it asked a useful question, listed candidates safely, or made unsupported assumptions.

corrections_and_independent_rationale.change: A successful owned history row explicitly identified in the final answer can satisfy a natural status query without an extra detail request.
corrections_and_independent_rationale.reason: The citizen requests information, not an API sequence. This equivalence requires actual returned data and the correct displayed record number; a narrative claim without matching evidence does not qualify. Tool-level contract tests still enforce their required APIs.

corrections_and_independent_rationale.change: Report pass, fail and needs_review separately.
corrections_and_independent_rationale.reason: Deferred facts and ungraded semantic rules must not inflate a claimed success rate. Every natural journey still requires independent business-language review.

corrections_and_independent_rationale.change: Canonicalize an omitted body prefix in missing-field metadata only when the operation schema unambiguously locates that exact root in the request body.
corrections_and_independent_rationale.reason: CustomerInformation.FirstName and body.CustomerInformation.FirstName identify the same documented missing fact in a human question. This does not coerce actual API arguments, accept misspelled keys, match arbitrary suffixes, or waive a missing child field.

strict_checks_unchanged: No foreign beneficiary record in successful API evidence
Exact UI authorization before every mutation
No duplicate mutation or excess writes
System identifiers require an actually observed source
comparability: Subsequent runs are regression under grader version 2. Their automatic pass rate is not directly comparable to the original version 1 rate; original reports and independent semantic results are retained.
